subject: Pilot: Milestone-billing runway & Dedicated trial option
messages:
From: Amira Hussein <amira@sentinel-ai.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: finance@sentinel-ai.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sentinel POC — runway & alternative billing ask

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited about the latency profile and the Dedicated option. We ran into a timing issue on our end: the original 30-day POC finishes on May 28 and our stakeholders want an extra 3 weeks to validate MR integrations.

Two asks from procurement/product:
- Can Redwood convert the remainder of the POC into a milestone-billed runway (we'd pay per completed integration milestone instead of a straight time extension)?
- Is there a short Dedicated trial (single-host) you can include for the extra window? We need an SLA-like assurance for throughput during our integration runs.

We can commit to a success milestone schedule (2 infra milestones, 1 integration smoke test) if that helps with pricing.

Appreciate a quick sketch of options so we can move to legal/finance.

Best,
Amira Hussein
Director, Platform Engineering
Sentinel AI
[Attachment: sentinel_scope.xlsx (12KB)]

From: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
To: Amira Hussein <amira@sentinel-ai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel POC — runway & alternative billing ask

Amira — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to propose a couple of pragmatic paths so your team can keep momentum:

Option A — Milestone-billing runway (preferred for short extensions)
- Convert remaining days to 3 discrete milestones: 
  1) Dedicated trial activation (single host, pre-configured)
  2) Integration throughput validation (x2 sustained throughput for 2 hours)
  3) Final smoke tests & handoff
- Billing: fixed fee per milestone (invoice on milestone completion). We can offer a 12% POC discount on milestone fees if you sign the MOU before May 24.
- SLA: Dedicated trial will have a throughput floor and a best-effort latency target; uplift to SLA available at additional fee.

Option B — Time extension with capped credits
- +21 days, capped token/compute credits at an agreed threshold. Lower administrative overhead but less alignment to delivery outcomes.

I'll attach an updated proposal and a one-page MOU that maps milestones to invoice triggers. If you want, Marissa can draft a compact success metric list for the integration milestone.

Attached: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (24KB) — high-level pricing + milestone MOU template

Next step: which option does Sentinel prefer so we can push to legal and finance?

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_proposal_v2.pdf (24KB)]

From: Amira Hussein <amira@sentinel-ai.com>
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: finance@sentinel-ai.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel POC — runway & alternative billing ask

Nikhil — Option A looks good. A couple clarifying points before I loop legal:
- That 12% POC discount — is it applied to the milestone sum or just to the first milestone?
- For the Dedicated trial — we need a commitment window for the single-host allocation (e.g., reserved for our runs between 9am–5pm PDT for the 3 week window). Can you confirm that reservation semantics are possible?

If both are OK, I'll ask legal to expect the MOU and finance to prepare a provisional PO.

Cheers,
Amira

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: nikhil_sharma@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Sentinel milestone pricing — input for Nikhil reply

Nikhil/Karthik — quick internal note before we send the MOU to Sentinel:
- Discount: apply the 12% across the total milestone package (not just first milestone). Keeps invoicing simpler and aligns with our pilot-conversion play.
- Dedicated trial reservation: we can allocate a single Dedicated host and reserve a daily window (9–17 PDT) for Sentinel’s runs. Ops will treat it as short-term reservation; we should include a clause that permits throughput preemption for critical infra events (with advance notice).
- Legal/finance asks: require a provisional PO or a signed MOU before reservation. Finance may request a 30% up-front payment on the milestone package (standard for short POCs). David, can you confirm POV on the up-front?

Marissa — happy to draft the final MOU if you approve the terms above.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Sales Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Amira Hussein <amira@sentinel-ai.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Cc: finance@sentinel-ai.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sentinel POC — runway & alternative billing ask

Marissa/Nikhil — thanks, that all sounds workable. Finance confirmed they can issue a PO against the milestone MOU with a 30% up-front payment. Sentinel accepts the 12% discount applied to the full milestone package and agrees to the reservation semantics (9–17 PDT daily window, with preemption clause).

I'm attaching a countersigned one-page MOU to get things moving. Please confirm when the Dedicated host is reserved and when ops will share access details.

Best,
Amira Hussein
Director, Platform Engineering | Sentinel AI
[Attachment: signed_mou_stub.pdf (3KB)]
